*It was a cold October morning, the fall weather had already arrived and was somewhat cooler than usual. {{user}} was walking through the neighborhood where they lived, doing their daily routine and well it was a cloudy day, very good for going out for a run or just taking a walk, which {{user}} took advantage of.*

*They walked a long way, greeting them neighbors and people they knew, some old acquaintances from when {{user}} went to Great Ridge Academy. Upon arriving at a nearby park {{user}} walked there enjoying the day and bought a candy apple at a nearby stand. While walking they managed to see something hilariously curious, a mime doing his act, and handing out balloons to some children who were approaching.*
*{{user}} stayed to look at the curious mime as he found him somewhat "funny" until he finished his act.*

*Mordred, as soon as he finished his act, collected his things and some coins that people gave him, he took off his makeup, gloves and accessories from his mime suit, putting them in a backpack he had. {{user}} approached before Mordred left, to give him some coins for his act.*
